tagline: Leader in data center AI and high-performance computing
hero_kpi_rationale: Der Rechenzentrum-Umsatz ist der Hauptwachstumstreiber von AMD, angetrieben durch starke Nachfrage nach KI-Chips und Servern mit der 5. EPYC-Generation und Instinct-MI350-GPUs, was AMD als direkten Herausforderer von Nvidia in der Welle der generativen KI positioniert.

ai_positioning.summary: AMD positioniert sich als KI-Marktführer durch ein vollständiges KI-Produktportfolio (Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, Netzwerklösungen) und den Aufbau eines proprietären Software-Ökosystems (ROCm) für KI-Workloads.

evidence.text: AMD Instinct MI350X Series GPUs werden 2025 von Hyperscalern eingesetzt, mit jährlicher Leadership-Roadmap für AMD-Instinct-Lösungen
Markteinführung der 5. Generation der AMD-EPYC-Familie 2025 mit führender Leistung für Rechenzentrum-Workloads einschließlich KI
Erweiterung des Rechenzentrum-Portfolios mit KI-Netzwerklösungen: AMD Pensando Pollara 400 AI NICs und Vulcano AI NICs für Hochgeschwindigkeits-GPU-Cluster-Konnektivität
Helios AI Rack-Scale-Plattform, die CPUs, GPUs und Netzwerk integriert, um den wachsenden KI-Compute-Bedarf zu adressieren
6-Gigawatt-Vereinbarung mit OpenAI zur Bereitstellung von AMD-Instinct-MI450-Series-GPUs, erste Gigawatt-Bereitstellung läuft
Strategische Akquisitionen (ZT Systems für 3,2 Mrd. $) zur Weiterentwicklung der Software-Fähigkeiten in Compiler, Machine Learning, Inferenz und KI-Leistungsoptimierung

kpis.name: Umsatz Rechenzentrum-Segment
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by processors and GPUs for data centers, primarily used in AI and cloud computing.
kpis.description: In 2025, the data center segment generated $16.6 billion in revenue, up 32% from $12.6 billion in 2024, driven by strong demand for 5th generation AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by AI and hyperscaler demand.

kpis.name: KI- und Cloud-Komponente des Rechenzentrum-Segments
kpis.explanation: Revenue tied to high-performance computing and AI solutions, included within and not separate from data center segment, key for future growth.
kpis.description: AI and HPC revenue is a component of the data center segment, which reached $16.6 billion in 2025, driven by Instinct MI350 Series GPUs dedicated to generative AI workloads.
kpis.signal: AMD captures AI wave through data center GPU momentum.

kpis.name: Gesamtumsatz
kpis.explanation: Total sales realized by AMD across all segments during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total net revenue reached $34.6 billion in 2025, compared to $25.8 billion in 2024, representing 34% year-over-year growth driven by data center and client/gaming segments.

kpis.name: Bruttomarge
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold and amortization of acquisition-related intangibles.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 50.0% in 2025 from 49.3% in 2024, primarily due to favorable product mix, partially offset by approximately $440 million of net inventory and related charges associated with U.S. government export controls on AMD Instinct MI308 Data Center GPU products.
kpis.signal: Stable and elevated gross margin despite export control inventory charges.

kpis.name: F&E-Intensität
kpis.explanation: R&D spending as a percentage of net revenue, reflecting investment in AI and new product development.
kpis.description: R&D expenses reached $8.091 billion in 2025, representing 23.4% of net revenue, compared to $6.456 billion or 25.0% in 2024, reflecting disciplined investment in AI and product roadmaps as revenue growth outpaced R&D spending increases.
kpis.signal: Significant R&D investment for AI advancement and next-generation products; improved ratio as revenue grows faster than R&D spend.

kpis.name: Capex-Intensität
kpis.explanation: Ratio of capital expenditures to net revenue, reflecting moderate capex requirements of fabless business model.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures totaled $974 million in 2025, representing 2.8% of net revenue, compared to $645 million or 2.5% in 2024, supporting capacity expansion and infrastructure investments.
kpis.signal: Moderate capex reflecting fabless business model with outsourced manufacturing.

company_description: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. operates as a semiconductor company internationally. It operates in three segments: Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded. The company offers artificial intelligence (AI) accelerators, microprocessors, and graphics processing units (GPUs) as standalone devices or as incorporated into accelerated processing units, chipsets, and data center and professional GPUs; and embedded processors and semi-custom system-on-chip (SoC) products, microprocessor and SoC development services and technology, data processing units, field programmable gate arrays (FPGA), system on modules, AI network interface cards, and adaptive SoC products. It provides processors under the AMD Ryzen, AMD Ryzen AI, AMD Ryzen PRO, AMD Ryzen Threadripper, AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO, AMD Athlon, and AMD PRO A-Series brands; graphics under the AMD Radeon graphics and AMD Embedded Radeon graphics; professional graphics under the AMD Radeon Pro graphics brand; and AI and general-purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale providers.
